notes:
V0.0.7: improved large CSV scanning, selected-antenna parsing, tab-delimited CSV support, and faster batch chart rendering.
V0.0.8: add SPC mode support.
V0.0.9: add View All support and keyboard arrow navigation for image preview.
V0.0.10: merge all CSVs in SPC date folders, add SPC multi-date single-antenna overlay preview, add fullscreen image preview, improve natural antenna sorting, and add clickable current-version release notes.
V0.0.11: add SPC Holder split-detail switch, support L/R summary grouping, and preserve exact Holder ID labels when detail is enabled.
V0.0.12: remove average preview traces, keep SPC group labels in the legend, and align highlighted sample line width with standard traces.
V0.0.13: add strict Overall Result PASS/FAIL/ALL filtering across all modes, and show per-group legend counts as N=xx.
V0.0.14: support ANT-leading S-parameter CSV columns (e.g. ANT1_S32:IL(S21_IL)Band:b1:10.000M Mag) and Resonance range columns, color individual traces PASS/FAIL from the Failing Bands column, and add an intranet edition with online update disabled.
